messages:
Maya Fernandez: Heads up finance — HelixThera (acct HT-412) opened a dispute for May dedicated commit invoice INV-2026-0502-HT. They say a node preempt on 2026-05-02 throttled their pool and resulted in ~220k tokens of burst overage. They're asking for the burst removed + a 15% SLA credit on reserved fee.
Ben Li: Can you paste the usage snapshot? I can verify telemetry against ded pool logs.
Maya Fernandez: They attached a screenshot but TL;DR: committed = 2,000,000 tokens, billed = 2,220,000, overage = 220k. Invoice total $14,320 (includes reserved monthly fee). Overages alone ~ $990 at our $0.0045/1k post-commit rate.
appops-bot: New incident note: pool ded-3b-2 recorded preemption event 2026-05-02T11:17:00Z, degraded throughput until 2026-05-02T11:59:00Z (42m). Cache warm start observed.
Ben Li: Verified: median throughput drop ~45% during window; there were some queued requests that retried. Looks like cache warm misses increased token counts by ~10k due to retries, but main effect is lost burst capacity.
Ivy Torres: Quick calc for options:
```
Committed tokens: 2,000,000
Billed tokens: 2,220,000
Overage: 220,000 tokens -> (220,000/1000)*0.0045 = 220*0.0045 = $0.99k => $990
Reserved monthly fee portion (ratio of invoice) = $8,000 (approx)
15% SLA credit request => 0.15 * $8,000 = $1,200
```
Ivy Torres: Notes: per policy SLA credit is typically future-credit unless refund approved. Refund threshold: treasury allows refunds < $2k without exec review.
Harper Nguyen: Customer success note: HelixThera is onboarding 3 additional teams this quarter. Risk of churn if we deny. Customer asks explicitly for refund of overage amount (they paid already) and SLA credit applied to next invoice.
payments-bot: Payment found: card txn settled 2026-05-03 02:12 UTC for INV-2026-0502-HT. Overages part cleared. Refund possible.
Maya Fernandez: Proposed resolution: refund $990 (overage) + apply 15% SLA credit ($1,200) to next invoice as memo. Net impact = $2,190 (credit + refund). Approve?
Ben Li: Ops ok with verification. Recommendations: honor SLA credit; refund overage to keep CS happy.
Ivy Torres: Approving finance adjustment. Will open ADJ-2026-8123 and tag treasury for refund TR-REF-2026-177.
Harper Nguyen: I'll confirm acceptance with customer and request they sign the SLA incident acknowledgement doc.
payments-bot: Treasury note: Refund ticket TR-REF-2026-177 created; auto-approve for refunds < $2k. Processing in 1-3 business days.
Maya Fernandez: Thanks all — will update HelixThera and close when refund posts. :white_check_mark: 
appops-bot: Billing adjustment ADJ-2026-8123 linked to INV-2026-0502-HT created by Ivy Torres.
